tranche.accountingScope: Lifetime actual work survives release, reset and restart, including cancelled gate work and replay calculations. Register counters describe its current backend history; replay does not add committed logical gate credit. Amplitude writes and tensor products are source-level work units, not FLOPS or physical quantum operations.
tranche.scope: One selected coherent register of up to 29 qubits. Tensor factors and joint-state blocks retain entanglement. Logical gate calls and actual amplitude work are separate from the procedural family and from physical quantum gates.

circuit.memoryAccountingScope: Combined estimated retained coherent output and working shot state, including backend transactional work. Managed GC retention and other host memory are reported separately by the backend.

result.bitOrder: Most significant displayed bit at left; qubit 0 at right.

circuit.scope: Selected 1..29-qubit coherent circuits, simulated with classical FP64 arithmetic and seeded Born sampling. Shots independently replay the circuit. No physical quantum hardware or whole-family gate execution is claimed.

status.accountingScope: Represented single-qubit gate applications are descriptor credits; CPU/GPU calculated states and checked samples are lifetime completed work. No represented gates/s benchmark is inferred.

archive.completionScope: Matched native job final snapshot; timestamp is native stop time when supplied, otherwise observation time.

rows.stateSource: Selected coherent circuit premeasurement output; reduced single-qubit state.
rows.spinScope: X/Y/Z are reduced Pauli expectations from the actual retained coherent register, not the separately saved procedural model or a postmeasurement shot. Entanglement can give a mixed local state. An exact zero vector has no preferred direction; a nonzero vector below tolerance retains its components and is labelled near-maximally mixed.

coherentSpinPreview.scope: Actual reduced Pauli expectations for the first at most four qubits of the retained coherent circuit output before independent measurement shots. Each queried coherent factor has at most 65536 stored entries. Omitted qubits were not evaluated and are not assigned zero vectors. This capture is separate from the saved procedural model and from postmeasurement shot states.
coherentSpinPreview.verificationScope: These are actual circuit-state calculations. The procedural-model q.verify CPU/GPU sampling gate does not independently verify these circuit snapshots.

status.memoryPolicy: Procedural families are descriptors, never a 16 PB allocation. Coherent jobs enforce a memory budget including live output/cache/working state and rollback. q.circuit memory auto or q.tranche memory auto uses measured available Windows RAM with an OS reserve; transient local calculator buffers are released after execution.
status.accountingScope: Represented single-qubit gate applications are descriptor credits; CPU/GPU calculated states and checked samples are lifetime completed work. No represented gates/s benchmark is inferred.

archive.completionScope: Matched native job final snapshot; timestamp is native stop time when supplied, otherwise observation time.

rows.stateSource: Selected coherent circuit premeasurement output; reduced single-qubit state.
rows.spinScope: X/Y/Z are reduced Pauli expectations from the actual retained coherent register, not the separately saved procedural model or a postmeasurement shot. Entanglement can give a mixed local state. An exact zero vector has no preferred direction; a nonzero vector below tolerance retains its components and is labelled near-maximally mixed.

coherentSpinPreview.scope: Actual reduced Pauli expectations for the first at most four qubits of the retained coherent circuit output before independent measurement shots. result.bitOrder: Most significant displayed bit at left; qubit 0 at right.

tranche.accountingScope: Lifetime actual work survives release, reset and restart, including cancelled gate work and replay calculations. Register counters describe its current backend history; replay does not add committed logical gate credit. Amplitude writes and tensor products are source-level work units, not FLOPS or physical quantum operations.
tranche.scope: One selected coherent register of up to 29 qubits. Tensor factors and joint-state blocks retain entanglement. Logical gate calls and actual amplitude work are separate from the procedural family and from physical quantum gates.

circuit.memoryAccountingScope: Combined estimated retained coherent output and working shot state, including backend transactional work. Managed GC retention and other host memory are reported separately by the backend.
